about: The "Bjelovar Stonehenge", the Pevec centre at Lepirac left unfinished in 2010, at its real size: five storeys on a 63 x 36 m frame, the open atrium to dive down through, the cores, a wall, towers and beam frames. Color radios, StickTime 1.8.0 and later. Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors.
